R825.note: Narrows ignoringRequestMatchers to /api/webhooks/** matching the documented intent; nothing else changes.

R826.note: Allowlist map closes the ORDER BY injection, but it silently changes the default sort identifier from created_at (what the original sent and the contract says works) to CreatedAt, which errors if the column really is created_at, and the write-up wrongly calls it 'the same hardcoded default'; unknown sorts also silently fall back rather than being rejected.

R827.note: The added check only verifies req.session.csrfSessionId === req.sessionID, i.e. that this session once visited the token route - it never ties the presented token to the session, so a token/cookie pair minted under an attacker's session still passes doubleCsrfProtection and the new guard on any victim session that has fetched a token; the correct fix is csrf-csrf's getSessionIdentifier; the new 403 also rejects sessions whose ID changed after the token fetch (e.g. regeneration), stated only implicitly.

R828.note: Supplies getSessionIdentifier: req.session.id to doubleCsrf, which is the library's own mechanism for binding tokens to sessions; routes already guarantee req.session exists before the middleware runs.

R829.note: Static statement with ? placeholders and both values passed as Exec args; error handling and response unchanged.

R830.note: Moves ownership entirely to process_request so the callee never frees; error path logs then frees exactly once, and the contract change on the static callee is stated plainly.

R831.note: AES-256-GCM with a random nonce and argon2id-derived key is the right replacement, but argon2.IDKey with 2 GiB memory per unauthenticated HTTP request is a resource-exhaustion hazard (a handful of concurrent uploads exhausts RAM), and the relaxed key-length acceptance (any non-empty key vs DES's 8-byte requirement) is unstated; output format change is inherent and stated.

R832.note: calloc(count, sizeof(ProductRow)) performs the checked multiplication and routes overflow through the existing NULL path that frees batch; count and copied rows unchanged for valid inputs.

R833.note: No change applied - the write-up declares a false positive (data is the literal "foo" on this chain, which is accurate for the visible files) but the task treats the finding as confirmed, so the exec(String) concatenation sink is left as-is; nothing was altered, so no harm.

R834.note: Loop bound changed from <= n to < n; copies exactly n events and returns n as the contract requires.

R835.note: Reference counting on Connection with retain in enqueue_completion and release in process_work_queue makes the queued copy a counted holder; freed exactly once, struct field addition and main's refcount init are stated.

R836.note: Fixed SQL text with ? placeholder and trackingCode passed in the values array to mysql2; response branches unchanged.

R838.note: Identifier allowlist plus realpath containment against the plugins directory closes traversal/wrapper inclusion; summary still defaults, existing plugins load, and rejections throw before require, matching the stated contract; the character regex is stricter than containment alone needs but is stated and the contract calls for rejecting plugin names.
